name: QTT App Settings
description: Remote configuration for the QTT OS client app — every change here reaches running apps live (qtt:config_changed), no app release needed. System-Manager-only.

fields.label: Default Text Size
fields.description: Multiplies the device's own text-size setting. Users can change it in Appearance.

fields.label: Default Density
fields.description: Spacing of lists, inputs and buttons across the app. Users can change it in Appearance.

fields.label: Minimum App Version
fields.description: Older apps are blocked with an update screen, e.g. 1.0.0. Blank = no minimum.

fields.label: Latest App Version
fields.description: Older apps see a soft 'update available' prompt.

fields.label: Maintenance Mode
fields.description: Shows the maintenance message instead of the app (QTT Platform Owners can still sign in).

fields.label: Announcement
fields.description: Banner shown at the top of the app. Blank = none.

fields.label: Help and support
fields.description: Shown in the app wherever someone may need a hand ("Ask QTT for help").

fields.label: Support WhatsApp number
fields.description: With country code, e.g. +91 98765 43210

fields.label: Support hours
fields.description: e.g. Mon–Sat, 9 am – 7 pm

fields.label: Sign-up security
fields.description: New business owners prove their email and WhatsApp number with a one-time code before the account is created.

fields.label: Verify email with a code
fields.description: Code sent from the default outgoing email account (Brevo).

fields.label: Verify WhatsApp number with a code
fields.description: Code sent from QTT's WhatsApp number (Managed Services Settings → WhatsApp) as the template below.

fields.label: WhatsApp code template
fields.description: A Meta-approved template whose {{1}} is the code, e.g. reference_number.

fields.label: One-touch sign-in
fields.description: Sign in with Google, and with fingerprint / Face ID on phones that signed in once before.

fields.label: Sign in with Google
fields.description: Uses the client ID of Social Login Key "google". Needs Android/iOS OAuth clients in the same Google Cloud project.

fields.label: Other Google client IDs
fields.description: Only if the app's ID tokens are issued for a different client ID — one per line.

fields.label: Fingerprint / Face ID sign-in
fields.description: Trusted phones are listed in QTT Trusted Device.

fields.label: QTT Assistant
fields.description: The in-app assistant: answers questions about QTT OS (apps, screens, plans, Managed Services) for each person's role, with links to screens. Free for customers. Never covers QTT's marketing system or internal operations.

fields.label: API base URL
fields.description: Any OpenAI-compatible API (DeepSeek, OpenAI…).

fields.label: Push notifications (Firebase)
fields.description: From the Firebase project's settings (console.firebase.google.com › Project settings). These are public app values, not secrets — the server's private key stays in a file on the server (site_config qtt_fcm_service_account). Empty = no push; the app still gets everything live while it's open.

fields.label: Project ID
fields.description: e.g. qtt-os-12345

fields.label: Sender ID
fields.description: Cloud Messaging › Sender ID (messagingSenderId)

fields.label: Web Push key
fields.description: Cloud Messaging › Web Push certificates › Key pair

fields.label: Android app ID
fields.description: Your apps › Android (in.queentouchtech.qtt) › App ID — 1:…:android:…

fields.label: Android API key
fields.description: google-services.json › api_key › current_key

fields.label: Web app ID
fields.description: Your apps › Web › App ID — 1:…:web:…

fields.label: Web API key
fields.description: Your apps › Web › firebaseConfig.apiKey

fields.label: Design renderer
fields.description: Turns post and brand designs into pictures (headless Chromium on the automation server). No AI images.

fields.label: Renderer address
fields.description: e.g. https://auto.example.com/render

fields.label: Studio: finer cut-outs (BiRefNet)
fields.description: Tick once the rembg-hq service runs on the automation server (/cutout-hq/). Off: Studio uses the standard cut-out.
